start.derivation: Recorded CC0 starter motor (Therancher01, Freesound 610771) crossfaded into a pitch-ramped catch from this bank's own recorded idle/rev loop.

stop.derivation: This bank's recorded idle loop pitch-ramped 1.0x -> 0.38x and faded over the 0.82 s runtime shutdown.

pops.derivation: Single exhaust pulses cut from this bank's own high-RPM recorded loops, enveloped and resequenced stochastically at runtime for overrun crackle.

off_throttle_derivation: Same recording as the matching on-throttle loop, cyclically low-pass filtered (no seam break) and set 4.5 dB quieter.
tire: Shared recorded tire_squeal_loop.wav from the Shelby bank (Tom Haigh, CC BY 3.0).
